title: Exploitation, class income and welfare in a Sraffian economy with consumption preferences
abstract: arXiv:2611.18345v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper develops a Sraffian model of simple reproduction in which production prices and functional income distribution remain classically determined, while class consumption is chosen optimally at those prices and incomes. it then shows that once workers and capitalists choose consumption bundles according to class-specific preferences, rather than consuming fixed baskets, surplus value, exploitation rates, total profits, and capitalist welfare need not rise monotonically with the profit rate. The framework defines distributive Engel curves, tracing how consumption, profits, labor exploitation, and welfare vary along the wage-profit frontier. Higher profitability may expand capitalists' nominal claim on surplus, yet alter relative prices in ways that reduce their real consumption and welfare. The result qualifies standard Marxian and Sraffian accounts of net product distribution based on the wage-profit curve.

translated_title: 具有消费偏好的斯拉法经济中的剥削、阶级收入与福利
translated_abstract: 本文构建了一个斯拉法学派的简单再生产模型，其中生产价格与功能性收入分配仍按古典方式决定，而阶级消费则在这些价格和收入水平下被最优地选择。研究表明，一旦工人和资本家按照各自阶级特有的偏好选择消费组合，而非消费固定篮子，剩余价值、剥削率、总利润和资本家福利就不再必然随利润率单调上升。该框架定义了“分配恩格尔曲线”，用以追踪消费、利润、劳动剥削和福利如何沿工资-利润边界变化。更高的盈利能力可能扩大资本家对剩余产品的名义索取权，但同时会通过改变相对价格而降低其实际消费和福利。这一结果修正了基于工资-利润曲线的标准马克思主义和斯拉法学派关于净产品分配的解释。
tldr: 本文构建了一个引入阶级消费偏好的斯拉法简单再生产模型，证明剩余价值、剥削率、利润和资本家福利并不必然随利润率单调上升，从而修正了基于工资-利润曲线的传统马克思主义与斯拉法学派分配理论。
